stem: Formative diagnostic check 11: Why is a one-factor nutrient explanation often weak when several mineral inputs changed together?
choices: Plants cannot respond to individual nutrients.
All mineral deficiencies have identical symptoms.
Nutrients can interact, so plant response may depend on combinations rather than one input acting independently.
EC identifies every ion concentration separately.
rationale: Cannabis response-surface work found interaction effects among N, P and K on multiple growth attributes.
